prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A crisp, high-resolution product photo of a white t-shirt displayed on a mannequin against a dark, neutral background. The t-shirt features a vibrant, stylized graphic printed on the chest: a dynamic sunset beach scene with a lone surfer riding a curling wave. The composition is framed by tall, silhouetted palm trees on either side, their fronds arching inward. The sky is ablaze with warm orange, pink, and gold hues, fading into soft purples and blues, suggesting the golden hour. A dramatic bolt of lightning splits the sky vertically, adding energy and contrast to the tranquil seascape. The water is rendered in cool blues and aquas, with white highlights accentuating the motion of the surf. The overall style is bold and graphic, reminiscent of retro travel posters or modern vector art, with clean lines and a slightly exaggerated, cinematic sense of scale. The lighting on the t-shirt is even and soft, emphasizing the vividness of the print and the smooth texture of the fabric, while the background remains unobtrusive, ensuring all focus remains on the garment and its artwork.
